robot_operations.name: Move To Home
robot_operations.description: Moves the robot from any position to home position using a PTP motion.

robot_operations.name: Move To Position
robot_operations.description: Moves the robot from any position to a position specified by the parameters using a LIN motion.

parameters.name: Base Frame ID
parameters.description: Index of the robot base frame used for the motion.

parameters.name: X Position
parameters.description: Target X coordinate, in 10um steps (1 mm * 100).

parameters.name: Y Position
parameters.description: Target Y coordinate, in 10um steps (1 mm * 100).

parameters.name: Z Position
parameters.description: Target Z coordinate, in 10um steps (1 mm * 100).

parameters.name: Z Rotation (A)
parameters.description: Target Z rotation, in 0.01 degree steps (1 deg * 100).

parameters.name: Y Rotation (B)
parameters.description: Target Y coordinate, in 0.01 degree steps (1 deg * 100).

parameters.name: X Rotation (C)
parameters.description: Target X coordinate, in 0.01 degree steps (1 deg * 100).

robot_operations.name: Approach
robot_operations.description: Approaches the specified position through an intermediate position specified by the offest using a LIN motion. Start and end of the program are in the home position.

parameters.name: Base Frame ID
parameters.description: Index of the robot base frame used for the motion.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Offset in the Z direction of the tool used to generate intermediate approach position for the motion, in 10um steps (1 mm * 100).

parameters.name: X Position
parameters.description: X coordinate of the final position, in 10um steps (1 mm * 100).

parameters.name: Y Position
parameters.description: Y coordinate of the final position, in 10um steps (1 mm * 100).

parameters.name: Z Position
parameters.description: Z coordinate of the final position, in 10um steps (1 mm * 100).

parameters.name: Z Rotation (A)
parameters.description: Z rotation of the final position, in 0.01 degree steps (1 deg * 100).

parameters.name: Y Rotation (B)
parameters.description: Y rotation of the final position, in 0.01 degree steps (1 deg * 100).

parameters.name: X Rotation (C)
parameters.description: X rotation of the final position, in 0.01 degree steps (1 deg * 100).
